authorization.authorized_slice: pre-inference study-design, falsification, and disclosure contract only

canonicalization.serialization: UTF-8 JSON with keys sorted lexicographically and separators ',' and ':'
canonicalization.hash_scope: the complete decoded JSON object after removing only the top-level contract_sha256 field

C_i.name: complete_candidate_interval_set
C_i.definition: For participant i, C_i is the complete unordered set of maximal half-open, engine-distinct intervals over every manifest-valid candidate civil date, place, and timezone in the frozen candidate-construction evidence domain.
C_i.freeze_rule: C_i and its construction manifest are content-hashed and frozen before any inferential response evidence is collected or exposed.
C_i.completeness_rule: No interval may be omitted, ranked, duration-weighted, pruned, or merged across a full-state change.
C_i.candidate_evidence_rule: Candidate date, weekday, source, and lineage fields may come from any source class accepted by the evidence state machine, but remain isolated from the hidden value, precision, and deterministic derivatives of T_i.
C_i.reference_independence: T_i is unavailable to candidate construction and cannot alter C_i or its evidence lineage.

T_i.name: withheld_documentary_reference_interval
T_i.definition: For participant i, T_i is an independently sourced documentary reference-time interval that preserves the source record's actual temporal precision.
T_i.custody_rule: Raw T_i remains with an independent reference custodian and is unavailable to candidate construction, measurement development, model development, procedure execution, stopping, and returned-set construction.
T_i.evaluation_rule: An independent evaluator may compare a previously committed S_i with T_i only after the applicable method and output are frozen.
T_i.absence_rule: If no eligible independent reference interval exists, T_i is absent and participant i is ineligible for calibration or validation claims about recovery accuracy.

S_i.name: returned_candidate_subset_or_abstention
S_i.definition: For participant i, S_i is either an explicitly returned subset of C_i containing whole full-state intervals, or an explicit abstention.
S_i.subset_rule: Every non-abstaining member of S_i must be an unchanged member of the frozen C_i.
S_i.abstention_rule: Abstention returns no candidate subset and is reported separately; it is neither success nor error.
prohibited_forms: a newly manufactured interval not present in C_i
a ranked or weighted candidate list

eligibility_requirements: the source is documentary rather than memory-only
the record was created or maintained independently of this study's natal inference process
the source and custody lineage are auditable without exposing the reference to candidate construction or inference
the record's precision and rounding convention are recoverable as an interval
the reference was not derived from astrology, Human Design, relationship interpretation, questionnaire responses, or candidate comparison
eligible_source_classes: independently obtained civil or clinical birth record with auditable provenance
independently obtained certified extract or archive transcription with auditable chain to the underlying record
ineligible_as_accuracy_ground_truth: participant assertion without independently inspected documentary support
family recollection without an independently inspected documentary source
a time produced or adjusted through astrological or Human Design rectification
relationship history or partner testimony used as inferential evidence

a source whose reference value entered candidate construction, questionnaire generation, model fitting, procedure execution, stopping, or returned-set construction outside an authorized post-freeze evaluator comparison

precision_rules.general: Represent exactly the source-supported interval and its endpoint convention; never promote a coarse, rounded, bounded, or ambiguous record to an exact minute.
precision_rules.known_rounding: A record rounded to a declared unit is represented by the complete source-compatible rounding cell under the documented rounding convention.
precision_rules.unknown_rounding_convention: If the rounding unit is known but the direction or convention is not, preserve the union or bounding interval of all source-compatible interpretations and mark the ambiguity.
precision_rules.bounded_record: A before/after or between-times record remains the corresponding interval.
examples_of_coarse_precision: five-minute precision remains a five-minute-scale reference interval
fifteen-minute precision remains a fifteen-minute-scale reference interval
hour precision remains an hour-scale reference interval
precision_rules.memory_only: Memory-only times may support separately approved feasibility or reliability work but never define T_i for accuracy claims.

reference_standard.leakage_invalidation_rule: If T_i or any deterministic derivative of T_i influences C_i, candidate-evidence lineage, measurement content, model development, procedure execution, stopping, or S_i, participant i is invalid for calibration or validation and is reclassified as development-only.
reference_standard.authorized_calibration_comparison_rule: After the method, measurement specification, target, output form, analysis, and participant output are frozen, a separately authorized independent calibration evaluator may compare committed outputs with T_i only through the predeclared calibration procedure. Any outcome-prompted methodological revision converts exposed calibration components to development and requires fresh calibration components.

reference_intersection.definition: For a non-abstaining output, report whether the union of intervals in S_i intersects T_i.

temporal_width_retained.definition: For a non-abstaining output, report both the summed temporal duration of S_i and the ratio of that duration to the summed temporal duration of C_i.
temporal_width_retained.unit: elapsed seconds plus a dimensionless retained fraction

full_state_interval_count_retained.definition: For a non-abstaining output, report both the number of full-state intervals in S_i and the ratio of that count to the number in C_i.
full_state_interval_count_retained.unit: interval count plus a dimensionless retained fraction

abstention.definition: Report whether the procedure explicitly abstained. Abstention is neither success nor error and is not recoded as covered or uncovered.

date_coverage.definition: When C_i spans civil dates, report the candidate dates represented by S_i, their count relative to dates represented by C_i, and whether any represented date intersects T_i; keep these outputs distinct from temporal width and state count.
date_coverage.applies_when: C_i contains intervals on more than one civil date

non_scalar_estimand.aggregation_rule: Report every component separately at participant and cohort level with abstentions visible. Do not combine components into a utility, score, preferred frontier point, or operating rule.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Return all of C_i without ordering or inferential response use.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Detects whether a proposed method improves on candidate construction alone and preserves candidate completeness.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Collect the same admissible responses but return all of C_i unchanged.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Detects whether apparent improvement comes from the response procedure rather than candidate structure or reporting conventions.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Generate participant-level random or permuted subsets matched to a proposed output's retained temporal width without matching on state count.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests incremental information beyond temporal compression alone; it is not a probability model.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Generate participant-level random or permuted subsets matched to a proposed output's retained full-state interval count without matching on temporal width.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests incremental information beyond state-count compression alone; it is not a probability model.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible calendar structure without any HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether calendar information accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible seasonal structure without any HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether seasonal information accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible birthplace information without any HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether location structure accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible timezone information without any HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether timezone structure accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible cohort membership without any HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether cohort structure accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use admissible candidate-source quality metadata without any HD state or access to T_i.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether source-quality structure accounts for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use only predeclared response-process features such as missingness or generic response style, without questionnaire content meaning or HD state.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether response process artifacts account for the observed frontier.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Permute participant-to-chart labels at the participant or connected-component unit while preserving the predeclared clustering structure.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether the result survives destruction of the participant-chart association.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Compare with plausible charts not belonging to the participant while matching predeclared nuisance structure.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests specificity to the concealed participant-chart association rather than generic descriptive fit.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Evaluate concealed candidate-to-participant matches with collectors, coders, method operators, and evaluators blinded according to their role.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: Tests whether unblinded expectancy, identity cues, or Forer/Barnum acceptance explains the apparent result.

baseline_falsification_matrix.definition: Use the strongest supportable ordinary non-HD method given exactly the same admissible inputs and development opportunity.
baseline_falsification_matrix.falsification_role: A future HD method must add out-of-sample information beyond this baseline; beating random assignment alone is insufficient.

baseline_claim_rule: No future HD recovery claim is supportable unless the frozen method shows incremental out-of-sample performance over the strongest applicable non-HD baseline and survives all applicable negative controls on untouched connected components; beating random assignment alone is insufficient.

development.outcome_feedback: Only an independent evaluator may compare a committed S_i with T_i. Released development diagnostics may inform a later version, after which the affected component remains development-only.

calibration.purpose: Apply a predeclared calibration procedure to outputs from a method, measurement specification, target, output form, and analysis plan frozen before calibration access.
calibration.contamination_rule: Any methodological revision prompted by calibration data converts every exposed calibration connected component to development and requires a fresh unexposed calibration cohort.

locked_validation.purpose: Evaluate the fully frozen method and analysis plan once the validation lock is released.
locked_validation.access_rule: Validation candidate records, responses, references, labels, and outcomes remain inaccessible to developers and calibration actors until the method, baselines, analyses, and disclosure plan are content-hashed and frozen.
locked_validation.contamination_rule: If validation information affects methodology, all exposed connected components become development and a new untouched validation cohort is required.

measurement_developer.inferential_responses: development-only under a later approved item-writing protocol

independent_calibration_evaluator.C_i_inputs: frozen manifest and component identity only
independent_calibration_evaluator.access_condition: method and output frozen; predeclared calibration comparison only

independent_validation_evaluator.C_i_inputs: frozen manifest and component identity only
independent_validation_evaluator.access_condition: method and output frozen; predeclared validation comparison only

connected_component_split.graph_definition: Construct an undirected graph before role assignment. Participant identities are vertices. Add an edge whenever either identity could transmit labels, reference information, response content, or relationship information to the other. Assign entire connected components to exactly one data role.
edge_classes: same participant or repeated identity under any alias
partners or members of the same relationship pair
participants connected through any relationship chain
participants linked to the same label-transmitting record source or record custodian
connected_component_split.cross_role_rule: No vertex, repeated observation, alias, partner, household member, relationship-connected participant, or shared record-source component may cross development, calibration, and locked-validation roles.
freeze_evidence: edge manifest digest with reason codes
connected_component_split.relationship_rule: Relationship evidence is excluded from natal inference. Any later separately approved relationship-assisted exploration permanently disqualifies the relationship and its entire connected component from natal calibration and validation.

the relationship connected component is development-only; replace validation

the transitive relationship connected component is development-only; replace validation
the shared-source connected component is development-only; replace later-role cohorts
participant is development-only and invalid for calibration or validation

participant is development-only and invalid for calibration or validation
participant is development-only and invalid for calibration or validation
all exposed calibration components become development; obtain fresh calibration components
all exposed validation components become development; obtain a new untouched validation cohort

measurement_development_requirements.checkpoint_gate: Any item-writing phase requires a new ChatGPT Pro checkpoint before questions, response choices, scoring keys, or chart-linked interpretations are authored.

required_future_evidence.requirement: Estimate stability over a predeclared retest design while retaining within-participant clustering.
Predeclare the coding unit, rater population, and agreement target before any human or model-assisted coding reliability claim.
Characterize item and participant missingness without treating unknown or context-dependent responses as chart support.
Measure generic assent, extremity, and other response-style effects separately from any future target.
Assess whether desirable self-presentation explains response patterns.
Use blinded and mismatched-description controls to test generic personal-validation effects.
Audit whether wording exposes a chart label, system vocabulary, intended feature, or preferred answer.
Map dependence and redundancy among future constructs so repeated wording is not counted as independent evidence.
Evaluate response-process and measurement comparability across every language and population for which a claim is contemplated.
Separate authorship, coding, and evaluation from held-out chart and T_i labels wherever practical, and record every unavoidable exposure.
Generate and revise future measurement content only in development, with held-out calibration and validation labels inaccessible.

proof_no_measurement_content_written.assertion: This contract specifies only future measurement-development controls and contains no questionnaire content, response scale, scoring key, chart-to-response mapping, or participant interpretation.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Interval representation preserves documentary precision, but population censoring methods do not directly choose among one participant's candidates.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A frozen estimand and evidence that the adapted method is valid for participant-level set evaluation without inventing within-interval mass.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: No defensible natal candidate prior is established, and this contract prohibits selecting one.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: Independent external justification, a predeclared sensitivity family, untouched validation, and a new Pro authorization.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Calibration principles constrain claims, but no probabilistic or operating semantics are selected.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A frozen output target, separate untouched calibration components, appropriate diagnostics, and subsequent validation.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Explicit abstention prevents forced precision, but choosing a reject rule requires a later operating-point decision.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A frozen loss-independent reporting design, separate calibration, frontier evidence, and owner authorization of an operating point.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Set-valued output is structurally relevant, but exchangeability, sample scale, target definition, and connected grouping remain unresolved.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A fixed target, exchangeable untouched calibration components, participant-level grouping, and empirical coverage evaluation.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Reliability, missingness, response-style, and invariance checks are standard constraints that do not select natal semantics.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A later approved frozen measurement protocol and development-only reliability evidence before inferential use.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Group separation directly prevents identity, household, relationship, and shared-source leakage.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A pre-outcome graph and role-assignment digest plus synthetic leakage tests.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Every adaptive operation belongs inside development; final evaluation must use untouched connected components.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: Executable provenance showing that all adaptive choices and data transformations remained within development.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: They test association and leakage but do not produce participant probabilities or establish validity by themselves.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: Predeclared component-level permutation units, nuisance preservation, and all applicable baseline results.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Post-selection claim limits apply whenever outcomes influence method or subgroup choices.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: Selection provenance and a genuinely untouched cohort for any confirmatory claim.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: Aggregate disclosure governance transfers, but small-cell, repeated-release, and linkage controls require a separate threat-model decision.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: A separately approved public-ledger threat model, synthetic release audit, and owner-approved release policy.

methods_decision_ledger.reason: They do not provide established blinded out-of-sample evidence and would introduce undeclared ranking semantics.
methods_decision_ledger.evidence_required_before_use: New independent blinded evidence and a later checkpoint would be required before reconsideration.
